name: Ladli Social Security Allowance Scheme
benefit: Under this scheme, a sum of ₹2750/- per month, per family will be given by the state government to those families who have solely girl child/children. The benefits will be provided for 15 years from the date of girls' parents completed 45 years of age. Note: After 60 years the "Ladli Social Security Allowance Scheme" will be converted into the "Old Age Samman Allowance Scheme". EligibilityAny family where biological single parent/parents are domicile of Haryana or working for the Government of Haryana and having no son, biological or adopted, but only daughter/daughters are eligible to get benefit. The gross annual income from all sources of the family must not exceed ₹2,00,000/- to be eligible for getting benefit under this scheme. The eligible family will be entitled to receive benefit under this scheme for a period of 15 years from the date either of the two parents completes 45 years of age. The benefit will be paid to the mother, if surviving. In case the mother is not surviving, the benefit will be paid to the father.
eligibility_rules: The following persons shall be excluded from the grant of benefit under this scheme: Those who themselves or their children are sales tax assesses. Those whose children are Class-I/Class-II Gazetted Officers in the services of the government or held equivalent posts of public sector undertaking or are employed under a private employer and draw salary equivalent to that of a Class-II Gazetted Officer. Those whose children are professional i.e. (a) Doctor, (b) lawyer, (c) Chartered Accountant, (d) Income Tax Consultant (e) Dental Surgeon, (f) Engineer or Architect (g) Contractor, etc. (This is only illustrative and all such professionals of similar nature may also be included) Those who themselves or their children are Income Tax Assesses. Those who themselves and their children are ex-sitting Members of Parliament/MLA/Chairman of Boards / Corporations. In case the guardian or any parent of the child is employed by any Government or by any Local/Statutory Body or any organization substantially financed by any Government or Local/Statutory Body or who is drawing pension or family pension therefrom will not be eligible under the scheme."Pension" wherever occurring in any Government notification concerning Social Security Benefit means and includes, income received or accrued from accumulated earnings, including schemes:-
Annuities from any source including Commercial Banks, Financial Institutions, or Insurance.

how_to_apply: Mode: Online & OfflineStep 01: The applicant needs to visit the office of the Social Welfare Department (DSWO) in his/her Block/District and collect the application form. The application form can also be downloaded from the Official Website.Step 02: The applicant should fill out the application form and attach all the essential documents.Step 03: After filling out the application form, the applicant needs to get attested to the form from the concerned authority as mentioned in the application form.Step 04: Then the application form has to be submitted to the office of the Social Welfare Department (DSWO) of your Block/District.
